title: Anyone else been to this house/cabin?
content: Disclaimer: I don’t remember everything exactly since the last I had this dream was a few weeks ago and I just recently learned about mall world. It’s this building that is either a cabin or a house in the middle of nowhere. It’s typically snowy but it can vary. There is also sometimes a sport field of some kind nearby. The building has two stories. The first floor is average house nothing too abnormal. There is also a small room like 7ft by 7ft room that looks kinda mystical, it’s also another bedroom. Furthermore, on the left side of the house there is a spiral staircase. When you take it you go to a crawl tunnel. On the other side there is a kids room full of toys that has a closet with vines from the top acting as a curtain door. There is also sometimes another version of the upstairs where it is a hotel room with three beds. There was something else about the house that I can’t remember but it was something important.
